entries.german:
Václav, král římský a český, ustanovuje Jindřicha z Rožmberka popravcem Bechyňského kraje a sděluje mu totéž jako v listině AČK 1366.Venceslaus, Romanorum et Bohemiae rex, Henricum de Rosenberg iustitiarium sive popravczonem districtus Bechynensis nominat et de iisdem, sicut in litteris AČK 1366, certiorem facit.

Siegel: sigillum Venceslai regis d 101 mm (cuius in dorso secretum rubri coloris d 28 mm est) in scidula membranacea appendet.
entries.english:
Wenceslaus, King of the Romans and Bohemia, appoints Heinrich von Rosenberg as judge of the Bechyně district and informs him of the same matters as in charter AČK 1366.

Seal: The seal of König Wenceslaus, diameter 101 mm (with a red secret seal on the reverse, diameter 28 mm), hangs from a parchment tag.
